fusions.name: Gap in the Plates
fusions.desc: Drives the blade through a join in the target's plate for 28 damage that ignores armour, and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Edged Lames
fusions.desc: Turns the sharpened edges of your plates through every enemy within 2 tiles, dealing 3 damage and leaving each [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Muffled Mail
fusions.desc: Absorbs 20 damage across up to 4 blows for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 8%. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sharpened Rondels
fusions.desc: Conjures bladed plate: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 6%, and 12% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. Your dodge chance rises by 3%.
